name: Rebecca Goosen
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Rebecca holds a Master of Counselling and creates space for women, couples and families to explore their internal experiences and navigate arising challenges. She is a Level 2 member of the Australian Counselling Association and a volunteer for Griefline. Her trauma-informed person-centred approach draws on her experience with somatics, nervous system regulation, pranayama (breathwork) and mindfulness.

name: Rebecca Harris
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: My counselling and psychotherapy work centres around an integrative, person-centred approach. I am a registered counsellor and I have post-graduate qualifications in developmental trauma, and counselling and psychotherapy. While I work with all clients, my particular areas of interest are working with children and young people, supporting parents at all stage of their parenting journey, and I particularly appreciate working with trans and gender diverse children and young people.
